definition.def: To transform something into something else means to change or convert it into that thing.
examples: Your metabolic rate is the speed at which your body transforms food into energy. [VERB noun + into]
Delegates also discussed transforming them from a guerrilla force into a regular army. [V n + from/into]

definition.def: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and suddenly so that they are much better or more attractive.
examples: The high-speed rail link is transforming the area. [VERB noun]
A cheap table can be transformed by an interesting cover. [VERB noun]
A love of rugby transformed him from a podgy child into a trophy winner. [V n + from/into]
The way in which we work has undergone a complete transformation in the past decade.
What a transformation! You look great.
the country's transformation from dictatorship to democracy

definition.def: the process of making institutions and organizations more democratic
examples: a lack of transformation in the private sector
